cohort: The study analyzed blood samples from 132 adults aged 21-49 who had experienced BCG osteitis in early childhood (cases) and a control group.
finding: The TLR2 and TLR6 variant genotypes were associated with a higher risk of BCG osteitis, while the TLR1 variant genotype was associated with a lower risk, indicating that gene polymorphisms in the TLR2 subfamily play a role in the development of BCG osteitis in vaccinated infants.
